data.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
AJCR_BUILD_LOCK=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
mkdir -p /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks
while ! mkdir "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$$" > "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK/pid"
release_ajcr_lock() {
  if test -f "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK/pid" && test "$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK/pid")" = "$$"; then
    unlink "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK/pid"
    rmdir "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK"
  fi
}
trap release_ajcr_lock EXIT
lake build AlgebraicJacobian'

/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
AJCR_BUILD_LOCK=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
mkdir -p /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks
while ! mkdir "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$$" > "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK/pid"
release_ajcr_lock() {
  if test -f "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK/pid" && test "$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK/pid")" = "$$"; then
    unlink "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK/pid"
    rmdir "$AJCR_BUILD_LOCK"
  fi
}
trap release_ajcr_lock EXIT
lake build AlgebraicJacobian'
